release_subject_semantics: Any future authorized execution must checkout exactly the reviewed release-subject commit. Later governance/review commits do not silently retarget the frozen release package.

head_bound_QA.workflow: ULSH-01 WP2 CP01R4 head-bound release QA v0.3

conditions_for_any_future_authorization_: The execution environment must checkout exactly d8890b9ef47936edf8bb7e758b882c898241b314; a changed release subject requires a new package freeze and authorization review.
The 16-member release package must recompute to SHA256 1d6f45725a66b145d2907943ddc7fe3a989411e5ccfe6c0f29053c91253c7621 before authorization and again before backend import.

The canonical target digest must remain 237c4b5e08a2106e13e985c4af7925f1899e2ae2e4b7253c7ab73cc2db5f1823 and the CP01R4 payload digest must remain 8e5976a22c4be78b5e4fe7834c9947de8a4acea7781363c7aeb83aa73982ac8c.
Python/dependency versions, one-thread BLAS environment, GPU-disabled state and network-isolation attestation must pass before grant reservation/backend import.
The operative reservation store must be a designated persistent execution store, not /tmp or an ephemeral CI workspace, and its identity/path must be recorded.
The explicit local result path must not exist before grant reservation and must remain governed by exclusive no-overwrite creation.
The reviewed release package must not be mutated between final preflight and backend import; any mutation requires a new package digest and review.

A separate filled AuthorizationDecision artifact must use the required status literal AUTHORIZED_SINGLE_USE_WP2_CP01R4_PRIMARY_TARGET_EXECUTION and bind the exact release subject, run, target and package digest.
A separate filled SingleUseGrant artifact must bind the same decision, release subject, run, target and package digest, have a unique grant_id and nonce, and have a valid active time window.
The grant must be atomically reserved before process resource mutation and before physical backend import; any reservation/replay conflict aborts fail closed.
WP3 and WP4 must remain unauthorized and must not start automatically after WP2 execution.
forbidden_inference: A green head-bound QA run is not physical evidence.
A frozen package digest is not a grant.
Single-use is asserted only within the designated persistent execution environment/store, not globally across independent machines or deleted/cloned stores.
No physical background, continuum existence, uniqueness, Fredholmness, stability, ghost freedom, response rank, K1-D release or K1-E admissibility follows from this review.
